text:
right, he was 12, shot in the leg, he was married at 10. he had two kids. Don't recall his name.
That is me on the left. I was probably looking at some reports. the stone is the french fort, my radio was outside. About 5 Airforce guys were putting in a radar? It had a search antenna that rotated that was built up in the boulders. The kid was with me all the time
